headline: President Ramaphosa Positions South Africa as AI Data Center Destination
summary: South Africa's President Cyril Ramaphosa promoted the country as a target for global artificial intelligence infrastructure investment during a speech in California, pointing to energy assets and industrial capacity.
why: South Africa is the continent's most industrialized economy, seeking digital technology and infrastructure capital.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Pitching South Africa as an AI data hub aims to attract foreign technology infrastructure investments.
